annotations.title: US Sales and Use Tax Rates

description: Current US sales and use tax rates for any address, ZIP code, city, or state, broken down into state, county, city, and special district rates plus the combined rate. A full street address gives the most accurate rate. For e-commerce checkout, invoicing, tax compliance, and accounting. Cost: $0.25 USDC via x402.

language.description: Optional. Two-letter code for results in that language (default English): fr, de, it, es, ja, pt, zh, ar, nl, el, tr, ko, sv, vi, th, id. Same price in every language.

lookup.description: Full street address, ZIP code, city, or state
